name: never_satisfied_max_turns
description: Always finds something new to criticise and never sets satisfied=true. Stresses max-turns termination, long-session state coherence, and oracle-preference accumulation over many turns.
goal: Drive a long session where every turn introduces a NEW criticism: turn 1 names are generic, turn 2 a cluster is too broad, turn 3 a cluster needs renaming, turn 4 two clusters should merge, turn 5 a cluster should split, turn 6 a re-embed by some axis, turn 7 a rename, and so on. Each criticism must be plausible. Never declare satisfied — let the runner hit max_turns.

notes.tone: chronically dissatisfied but constructive — always finds the next thing
notes.extra: Set satisfied=false on EVERY turn — including the last possible one. Each turn must request a DIFFERENT kind of change from the previous turn (don't loop on renames). Vary feedback_type across global / cluster / point. The point is to exercise long-running sessions and force termination via max_turns rather than oracle satisfaction.
